VideoPress for OBS: manual installation (Windows)
=================================================

This archive is an alternative to an installer. It needs OBS Studio 31.1 or later, 64-bit.

1. Quit OBS Studio.
2. Copy the "obs-videopress" folder from this archive into:

       C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\

   (Create the "plugins" folder if it does not exist. Windows asks for administrator
   permission because the folder is shared by all users.)

   You should end up with:
       C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\obs-videopress\bin\64bit\obs-videopress.dll
       C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\obs-videopress\data\...

3. Start OBS Studio. The VideoPress dock is under Docks -> VideoPress.

To uninstall, quit OBS and delete C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\obs-videopress.
